explanation: The measurements show that transfer-a has a white card section (id='delivery') positioned above the price note at both viewports, with bgAlphaTimesOpacity=1, effectively covering the text. In contrast, transfer-b has no such covering element above the price note, and its text pixels show visible dark ink (p05=147/111 vs reference p05=239), while transfer-a's text pixels are uniformly light (p05=239) matching the background. This directly supports the 'h-overlay' hypothesis for transfer-a.
